records.summary: Added a new, high-impact conditional XRP reserve-cushion calculation. The Edge's analysis of Binance's official 1 October 2026 PoR page reports XRP reserve coverage of 100.77% and customer net balances of 2.496B XRP (rounded to the nearest million); Gate News independently republishes the same ratio, and Binance's own PoR page describes the 1:1 method and exposes a Download All Address control. Using the reported rounded figures, implied pre-incident XRP reserve surplus is about 19.219M XRP. If all 233.4619431M XRP transferred from the five Binance-labelled XRPL source wallets came from PoR-listed reserves and no offsets were applied, the mechanical post-loss ratio would be about 91.42%, with a conditional shortfall of about 214.243M XRP. Only 8.23% of the transfer would exhaust the implied pre-incident surplus. This is a sensitivity scenario, not an observed reserve ratio: official membership of the five XRPL wallets in the PoR set remains unverified, and the company has since reported a $6.34B backstop, freezes and token replenishment work. No forecast or market feature admitted.
actions: Retrieved Binance's official PoR methodology page and confirmed it displays an all-address download control and describes reserve-wallet ownership verification.
Cross-checked The Edge's 1 October 2026 XRP reserve ratio and customer net-balance figures against Gate News reporting of the same 100.77% ratio.

Calculated a conditional stress sensitivity using the five-wallet 233,461,943.1 XRP incident transfer: 100% of the transfer from PoR-listed reserves would reduce modeled coverage to approximately 91.42%; the implied pre-incident surplus is exhausted at about 8.23% of the transfer.
Explicitly retained unknown official PoR membership for the five XRPL source wallets; no downloaded address export or raw account_info crosswalk was available.
Preserved the prior exact-head ledger validation (285 shards, 20 tests) and recorded the new addendum as pending its own validation.
blockers: The official Binance Download All Address file was not retrieved; the five XRPL source-wallet addresses cannot yet be crosswalked to the October 1 PoR set.
The Edge's 2.496B XRP customer net balance is rounded to the nearest million and its 100.77% ratio is rounded to two decimals; derived reserve amounts and stress ratios are approximate.
The conditional scenario excludes post-incident corporate treasury replenishment, frozen/recovered assets, SAFU support, any other reserve-wallet balances and any customer-liability changes.
